# Repositories the changelog leaves out, one id per line.
#
# An id is the first 12 hex characters of the sha256 of the repository's
# lower-cased name:  printf '%s' '<name>' | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-12
#
# A repository belongs here when the leak gate refuses its name in this
# repository's files. The id lets the collector skip it without this file
# stating the name. An owner removes the line when the name may be written.
#
# No repository is left out today.
